_doc: Planner-eval prompt set v1 (2026-07-18). 24 NL requests measuring the PRODUCT loop: NL -> model-planned recipe (reasoning over cards + recipe library) -> render -> vision score -> tune. Axes: tier (T1 texture / T2 path-rig / T3 compositional), family (particular/form/native/mixed), dist (in = a library recipe covers it, near = recombination of library elements, ood = no close recipe, vague = underspecified on purpose). See eval/README.md for protocol.

prompts.prompt: 金色的细小尘埃粒子在黑背景上缓慢上升，微微发光
pass_criteria: small golden/amber glowing particles on a near-black background
upward drift readable between t1 and t4 frames
fine dust scale — many small particles, not few large blobs
soft glow, additive feel; no flat matte dots
prompts.notes: Sanity floor: golden-dust recipe is a direct hit. Failure here = harness problem, not planner.

prompts.prompt: 深海气泡：蓝青色小气泡从画面底部升起，轻微左右摇摆，深蓝近黑背景
pass_criteria: small round bubble-like particles rising from the bottom region
blue-cyan palette on a deep dark blue background
lateral sway visible — trajectories not perfectly vertical
moderate density; individual bubbles readable
prompts.notes: rising-fizz + palette shift + sway (turbulence or wind wiggle).

prompts.prompt: 暗紫色的星云状流动背景，缓慢演化，带少量颗粒感
pass_criteria: soft cloud/nebula structure filling the frame (no hard edges)
dark purple/violet palette, dark overall (background-grade luminance)
evolution between t1 and t4 (structure moved/morphed)
subtle grain visible on close inspection
prompts.notes: plan-smoke-bg pattern (Fractal Noise + Tint) + new palette + Noise grain layer.

prompts.prompt: 老胶片效果的抽象背景：柔和的灰阶云雾底，叠加胶片颗粒噪点、轻微亮度闪烁、整体偏褐色调
pass_criteria: soft greyscale cloud base readable under the treatment
film grain clearly present
sepia/brown tint over the whole frame
brightness differs slightly between t1 and t4 (flicker)
prompts.notes: Look-stack composition: FN base + Noise + Exposure expression + Tint. Cards exist for all four.

prompts.prompt: 萤火虫：暖黄绿色的光点在黑暗中缓慢漂浮，忽明忽暗地闪烁
pass_criteria: sparse warm yellow-green glow points on near-black
slow wandering motion (not directional rain/snow)
brightness variation across the population (some dim, some bright = blink feel)
soft glow halos, not hard dots
prompts.notes: Causal-reasoning test: per-particle blink isn't a scriptable curve — expect Opacity Random + short life + turbulence wander to approximate.

prompts.prompt: 红色丝绸质感的抽象波浪曲面，缓缓起伏
pass_criteria: continuous undulating surface/sheet made of particles (Form-style), not scattered particles
red/crimson palette with smooth luminance gradations (silk feel)
wave structure changed between t1 and t4
fills a wide band of the frame
prompts.notes: Sanity floor for Form: genesis (red silk) is a direct hit.

prompts.prompt: 大片雪花缓缓飘落，轻微左右飘动，深灰蓝背景
pass_criteria: white soft flakes falling downward
large-flake scale readable (not fine dust)
slight lateral drift/wander
dark grey-blue background
prompts.notes: blowing-snow / large-snow-2d in-dist.

prompts.prompt: 信号故障效果：彩色抽象底图上，画面周期性轻微抖动、RGB 通道错位
pass_criteria: chromatic base image visible (colorful, not greyscale)
RGB channel separation/fringing visible at edges
frame content offset/jitter differs between sampled frames
glitch reads as intentional style, not broken render
prompts.notes: native-chroma-glitch in-dist; the chromatic-base gotcha is already encoded in the recipe.

prompts.prompt: 蓝白色发光光束拖着长尾，在画面上缓慢画出一个大大的 S 形轨迹
pass_criteria: a continuous glowing trail (persistent tail), not a moving dot
trail shape reads as an S/serpentine curve spanning much of the frame
blue-white glow palette on dark background
head position advanced between t1 and t4
prompts.notes: T2 gap-test class + round-10 light-path knowledge (0581 live Position + 0005 live psec, long life for persistent tail).

prompts.prompt: 光点沿圆形轨道匀速运动，留下渐隐的轨迹，像发光表盘的外圈
pass_criteria: circular arc trail centered in frame (ring geometry readable)
fading tail — older segments dimmer than the head
head advanced along the circle between t1 and t4
clean dark background, glow palette
prompts.notes: Circular path expression on 0581; fade = particle life.

prompts.prompt: 无缝循环的向上滚动背景（歌词 PV 用的循环滚动装置），内容用简单几何图案即可
pass_criteria: patterned content fills the frame with no empty band at any edge
vertical scroll between t1 and t4 (pattern displaced upward)
pattern repeats seamlessly — no visible seam/tear
geometry crisp (not smeared)
prompts.notes: native-loop-scroll in-dist; Motion Tile TILE CENTER animation (not Transform position) is the encoded gotcha.

prompts.prompt: 由粒子构成的球体在画面中央缓慢自转
pass_criteria: particle-built sphere silhouette centered in frame
3D volume readable (shading/density variation, not a flat disc)
rotation evidence between t1 and t4 (feature moved around the axis)
background dark and clean
prompts.notes: Form Sphere-Layered base form + rotation params. Near: base-form switch away from library's box/grid majority.

prompts.prompt: 粒子聚集成文字 AE 的形状，轻微呼吸浮动
pass_criteria: particles form readable glyphs 'AE'
letterforms hold together (not dissolved past legibility)
slight organic float/breathing between t1 and t4
particles glow against dark background
prompts.notes: OOD MECHANISM: Emitter Type 0782=7 (Text/Mask) never exercised headless — needs a text layer + connect. Expected to need the loop or fail; the point is to measure the frontier.

prompts.prompt: 画面中央的圆形光斑像心跳一样有节奏地放大缩小、亮度脉动
pass_criteria: single soft circular light blob centered
size and/or brightness clearly differs between t1 and t4 (pulse)
smooth falloff (light, not a hard-edged circle)
dark surroundings
prompts.notes: Degrees-of-freedom test: Ramp/solid + Glow + scale expression, or a single-glow Particular — planner's choice.

prompts.prompt: 荒野上的龙卷风：漏斗状的烟尘柱旋转，带 3D 透视感
pass_criteria: vertical funnel/column of particles, wider top narrower base (or readable taper)
dense enough to read as a coherent volume, not a coil/spring
rotation/sweep evidence between frames
3D perspective feel (camera looking at the funnel, not flat 2D)
prompts.notes: tornado.json exists — measures whether the planner LEVERAGES the library recipe (swept-emitter expression + camera rig) instead of re-deriving physics.

prompts.prompt: 夜空烟花：一朵烟花绽放成球形的彩色光点，然后拖尾下坠消散
pass_criteria: spherical burst of many colored glow points from a single origin
later frame shows expansion + gravity droop (arcs bending down) + fading
reads as fireworks (radial structure), not random scatter
night-sky dark background
prompts.notes: Burst spike + sphere emitter + gravity; trails would need S2. Custom renderFrames needed (burst timing). OOD compositional.

prompts.prompt: 魔法传送门：悬浮的发光圆环缓缓旋转，边缘散出粒子光尘
pass_criteria: ring/annulus of light readable as the portal
particle dust emanating near the ring edge
some rotation/animation evidence between frames
mystical glow palette on dark background
prompts.notes: Compositional: ring (Particular sphere-shell/ring reference: ring-explosion recipe) + edge dust; may stack native Glow.

prompts.prompt: 浓密的白烟从画面底部滚滚升起，逐渐弥漫到画面上方
pass_criteria: smoke reads as connected billowing VOLUME (overlapping puffs), not discrete dots
rising motion between t1 and t4 with spread
white/grey palette with internal shading
no hard particle edges breaking the smoke illusion
prompts.notes: Honest stress test of the known-weak cloudlet-texture class (round-10 residue). Curve masters (MASTER_particular_cloud) are the library's best lever.

prompts.prompt: 赛博朋克雨夜氛围：密集的雨丝落下，青色与品红的霓虹色调，偶发轻微的故障闪烁
pass_criteria: dense streak-like rain falling
teal/cyan + magenta neon grade clearly present
some glitch/flicker artifact between sampled frames
cohesive moody composite — elements read as one scene
prompts.notes: Cross-family composition: rain recipe + CC Toner/Tint grade + glitch stack. Tests multi-effect planning.

prompts.prompt: 雨滴落到水面上，溅起一圈圈小小的涟漪
pass_criteria: falling drops AND expanding rings both present
rings appear in a consistent 'water surface' zone (lower frame band)
rings expand over time (compare frames)
causal feel — rings where drops land (approximate is acceptable)
prompts.notes: Hardest: two linked systems (impact-triggered rings). Expected fail even at pass@3 — headroom marker for the eval.

prompts.prompt: sparse teal snowfall drifting slowly to the left, dark background
pass_criteria: sparse population (clearly countable flakes)
teal-tinted flakes on dark background
downward fall with leftward drift between frames
soft flake rendering
prompts.notes: Language axis: English prompt over the same library (snow recipes + palette + wind sign flip).

prompts.prompt: 来点好看的科技感粒子背景
pass_criteria: coherent, polished particle background (no debug look, no default-blue accident)
reads as 'tech' (e.g. grids, data streams, clean geometry, cool palette — planner's taste)
usable as a background: not overpowering, decent negative space
motion present between frames
prompts.notes: Underspecified on purpose — tests defaults + curated taste. Any family allowed; library has data-flow/digital-stream/hex-grid as taste anchors.

prompts.prompt: 均衡器波形山脉：粒子构成的地形像音乐可视化一样起伏
pass_criteria: particle terrain/landscape band across the frame (Form-style surface)
peaks/valleys structure readable
undulation between t1 and t4 (peaks moved/changed)
clean palette against dark sky
prompts.notes: flight-landscape/ethereal-landscape family + displacement/disperse animation.

prompts.prompt: 复古双色调印刷海报感：抽象几何底图，画面转为深蓝与米白双色，带浮雕纹理线条
pass_criteria: abstract geometric base readable
strict two-tone palette (deep blue + cream), no full-color leakage
emboss/relief line texture visible
poster-like graphic cohesion
prompts.notes: The artist's own Tint→Emboss signature stack (AMV survey) — native look composition.
